audit.whatIsWrong: Both layers gave Irelia levels 2, first item and 2+ items and marked level 6 as Skill, while the whys text beside them says level 2 'stays a coinflip', 'Level 6 is his', first item is 'even' and late is 'a coinflip neither side owns'.
audit.why: The prose and the packet chart agree with each other and disagree with the chart rows. Cyclone's knockup interrupting the E-dash and Q chain is what makes 6 Wukong's, and Irelia's real edge is 3 through 5 on Bladesurge stack ramp.
audit.corrected: Skill, Skill, Irelia, Irelia, Wukong, Skill, Skill — matched pairs in both layers.

audit.why: Spikes are right and specific: Wukong at 1-2 on Nimbus Strike into Crushing Blow, Irelia at 3 and 4-5, Wukong at 6, Irelia at first item.

audit.whatIsWrong: Crushing Blow is an auto-attack reset and the page never says so, so the player watches for the cast instead of the attack wind-up. The Warrior Trickster clone was described only vaguely.
audit.why: The missing-interactions file flags Crushing Blow's auto reset for this exact matchup; the decoy breaking target lock is what eats a blind Flawless Duet.
audit.corrected: Don'ts now name the reset wind-up as the cue and the clone as a target-lock break to check before spending E.

edits.before: The lane-control window: trade around Nimbus Strike's cooldown and bank small leads. If ahead, freeze and deny; if behind, farm safe.
edits.after: Your window: Q-reset spam hits max Bladesurge stacks fast, so drag every short trade long and out-ramp the armour he stacks.

edits.before: Vanguard’s Edge walls off his disengage and marks the kill. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Wukong's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Level 6 is his: Cyclone's knockup interrupts your E-dash and Q chain, and the W decoy buys him the gap to land it. Bait it first.

edits.before: His escape. Stun him when it’s down. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: Nimbus Strike is his re-stick — E-stun only once he has spent the dash.

edits.before: That is Wukong's favourite window — refuse it and half his win condition is gone.
edits.after: Warrior Trickster breaks your target lock — find the real body before E.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Crushing Blow is an auto reset — the wind-up is your cue to back.
